metadata.description: Agent Skills for creating production-ready images, video, audio, 3D, and custom models with Scenario

plugins.name: 01.-getting-started
plugins.description: Connect the Scenario MCP server and learn the core generation loop every other skill builds on.

plugins.name: 02.-finding-a-direction
plugins.description: Turn a blank brief into references, options someone can choose between, and a moodboard the next batch runs from.

plugins.name: 03.-images
plugins.description: Generate and edit images: model choice, sizing, references, masked edits, post-processing tools, and letter-perfect text overlay cards.

plugins.name: 04.-game-art-and-environments
plugins.description: Sprites, icons, tilesets, textures, skyboxes, and 3D assets ready for game engines.

plugins.name: 05.-video-and-audio
plugins.description: Video generation and editing, music, sound effects, voice, and speech.

plugins.name: 06.-consistency-and-custom-models
plugins.description: Hold one character, product, or style across a whole set, and train custom models on your own art.

plugins.name: 07.-reviewing-and-organizing-output
plugins.description: Read finished assets back: caption them, extract a style or a control map, check a batch against a brief or the Quality Gate, and file the keepers.

plugins.name: 08.-formats-and-placements
plugins.description: Ship one approved master, image or video, to every placement: ratios, safe zones, and platform specs from social feeds to shops, storefronts, and print.

plugins.name: 09.-workflows-and-apps
plugins.description: Discover, run, build, and publish Scenario workflows, the multi-step pipelines users call apps.

plugins.name: 10.-troubleshooting
plugins.description: Get past a blocked generation, and turn a stuck session into a reproducible public issue.

plugins.name: 11.-image-model-families
plugins.description: The top image families in depth: generation and editing modes, reference rules, and the caps that differ per member.

plugins.name: 12.-video-model-families
plugins.description: The top video families in depth: conditioning modes, native audio, editing and extension, and per-member caps and costs.

plugins.name: 13.-audio-model-families
plugins.description: The top audio families in depth: music, covers and stems, sound effects, speech, dubbing, and video scoring.

plugins.name: 14.-3d-model-families
plugins.description: The top 3D families in depth: mesh generation, retexture and rigging toolchains, portraits, and explorable worlds and splats.
